mentions.name: simplevc
mentions.description: A private, simple browser-based video chat with no accounts required: users can create a new chat or join via link or code. It includes in-browser transcription powered by Whisper (built on Hugging Face's candle library), and work is ongoing on smooth background blur for Chrome on Android.
mentions.problem: Choosing which video call platform to use for intro meetings was annoying.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://simplevc.blazingbanana.com. It’s a private, simple browser video chat. No accounts. You can create a new chat or join via link/code. It also has in browser transcription using Whisper (using https://github.com/huggingface/candle/).
